plan.title: Extend Closed RFQ by One Hour

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ without recreating or searching for another event.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Use the required tenant configuration for post-expiry surrogate bidding.
Enable buyer bid editing as required by the case.
Apply the required evaluation-reopen permission configuration.
Open the RFQ stage specified by the case.
Reach the Responses view before opening the RFQ Settings action.
Select the one-hour Increase Event Time option, save it, and verify the new end time is exactly one hour after the previous end time and that the dialog closes.
